reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Definition of knowledge
headings.reviewNote: Defines knowledge to include actual knowledge and bad-faith awareness of circumstances.

headings.title: Definition of notice
headings.reviewNote: Specifies notice delivery by direct statement or written delivery to business or residence.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1949 source note; knowledge (actual or bad-faith) and notice delivery rules verified.

headings.title: Inapplicability of strict construction rule
headings.reviewNote: Disapplies common-law strict construction rule to the Uniform Partnership Law.

headings.title: Application of law of estoppel
headings.reviewNote: Applies the law of estoppel under this chapter.

headings.title: Application of law of agency
headings.reviewNote: Applies the law of agency under this chapter.

headings.title: Construction to effect uniform law
headings.reviewNote: Directs uniform interpretation with other adopting states.

headings.title: Preservation of prior contracts and rights
headings.reviewNote: Preserves existing contracts, accrued rights, and pending proceedings.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1949 source note; all five Uniform Partnership Law construction and savings rules verified.

headings.title: Definition of partnership
headings.reviewNote: Defines partnership as an association for profit, including registered limited liability partnerships.

headings.title: Application to other associations and limited partnerships
headings.reviewNote: Excludes entities formed under other laws, applying to limited partnerships except where inconsistent.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1949, 1995); partnership definition including registered LLPs and LP applicability verified.

headings.title: Property brought in or acquired on partnership account
headings.reviewNote: Identifies property brought into stock or acquired for the partnership as partnership property.

headings.title: Presumption for property acquired with partnership funds
headings.reviewNote: Presumes property acquired with partnership funds is partnership property absent contrary intent.

headings.title: Real property acquired and conveyed in partnership name
headings.reviewNote: Permits acquiring real property in partnership name and restricts conveyance to partnership name.

headings.title: Conveyance passing entire estate of grantor
headings.reviewNote: Provides conveyance to partnership name passes entire grantor estate absent contrary intent.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1949 source note; tightened subsection 3 title to keep within 8 words while preserving real-property name rules.

headings.title: Partner as agent for partnership business
headings.reviewNote: Establishes partner agency for usual business and exceptions for lack of authority.

headings.title: Acts outside usual business
headings.reviewNote: Requires partner authorization for acts not apparently in usual business.

headings.title: Acts requiring unanimous partner authorization
headings.reviewNote: Lists acts requiring all partners' authorization unless others abandoned the business, including assignment, goodwill, and arbitration.

headings.title: Contravention of restrictions on authority
headings.reviewNote: Invalidates partner acts contravening known restrictions against third parties with knowledge.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1949 source note; partner agency, usual-business limits, unanimous-act list (with abandonment exception), and restriction rules verified.

headings.title: Conveyance of real property held in partnership name
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes conveyance of partnership real property and conditions for recovery.

headings.title: Conveyance in partner's own name
headings.reviewNote: Passes equitable interest when partner conveys in own name within authority.

headings.title: Title in some partners without recorded partnership right
headings.reviewNote: Governs conveyance where record title stands in name of fewer than all partners.

headings.title: Title held in trust or by partners
headings.reviewNote: Passes equitable interest for conveyance where title is held in trust or partners' names.

headings.title: Conveyance by all partners
headings.reviewNote: Passes all rights when conveyance is executed by all partners.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1949 source note; tightened subsection 3 title; all five real-property conveyance scenarios and § 358.090(1) cross-references verified.

headings.title: Joint and several liability of partners
headings.reviewNote: Establishes joint and several liability under §§ 358.130–358.140 and for other debts, subject to subsection 2; permits separate partner obligation.

headings.title: Limitation of partner liability in registered LLP
headings.reviewNote: Shields registered LLP partners from partnership debts, obligations, and liabilities.

headings.title: Exceptions for partner's own acts and tax liabilities
headings.reviewNote: Preserves liability for partner's own negligence, wrongful acts, or malpractice, ch. 143/144/301 revenue taxes, ch. 288 employment security liabilities, and § 32.087 local taxes.

headings.title: Party status in registered LLP proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Excludes partner as proper party in proceedings by or against a registered LLP unless personally liable under subsection 1 or 3.

headings.title: Registered LLP capacity to sue and be sued
headings.reviewNote: Permits a registered limited liability partnership to sue and be sued in its own name.

headings.title: Venue of claims against registered LLP
headings.reviewNote: Controls venue and establishes deemed county residency under section 508.010.

headings.title: Service of process on registered LLP
headings.reviewNote: Permits service of process on registered agent, partner, managing or general agent, or person in charge of business office.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text, history, and § 431.140 cross-reference note; refined subsections 3–5 titles to reflect local/employment taxes, proceedings by or against LLPs, and concise phrasing.

headings.title: Liability of partner by estoppel
headings.reviewNote: Imposes liability on persons representing or consenting to representation as partners.

headings.title: Agent status of person represented as partner
headings.reviewNote: Establishes agency authority of represented partner to bind consenting persons.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1949 source note; partner-by-estoppel liability and agency rules verified.

headings.title: Fiduciary duty to account for profits and benefits
headings.reviewNote: Requires partners to account for benefits and hold derived profits in trust.

headings.title: Application to representatives of deceased partner
headings.reviewNote: Extends fiduciary accountability to representatives of deceased last surviving partner.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1949 source note; partner fiduciary accounting duty and application to deceased last surviving partner's representatives verified.

headings.title: Rights and duties upon continuation beyond fixed term
headings.reviewNote: Maintains rights and duties consistent with partnership at will upon continuation.

headings.title: Prima facie evidence of continuation
headings.reviewNote: Establishes continuing habitual business without settlement as prima facie evidence.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1949 source note; fixed-term/undertaking continuation rights and prima facie evidence rule verified.

headings.title: Co-ownership as tenant in partnership
headings.reviewNote: Designates partner status as co-owner holding specific property as tenant in partnership.

headings.title: Incidents of tenancy in partnership property
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates incidents including possession, nonassignability, attachment limits, survivorship, and dower exemption.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1949 source note; tenancy in partnership status and all five statutory incidents verified.

headings.title: Effect of assignment of partner's interest
headings.reviewNote: Limits assignee rights to profits without management, inspection, or dissolution power.

headings.title: Rights of assignee upon dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Entitles assignee to assignor's interest and accounting from date of last agreed account.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1949 source note; assignee profit rights during continuance and accounting rights upon dissolution verified.

headings.title: Charging order and receiver on partner's interest
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court charging order and receiver for judgment creditor against partner interest.

headings.title: Redemption or purchase of charged interest
headings.reviewNote: Permits redeeming charged interest before foreclosure or purchasing at court-directed sale without dissolution, using separate or consented partnership property.

headings.title: Preservation of exemption rights
headings.reviewNote: Preserves partner's statutory exemption rights regarding interest in partnership.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1949 source note; refined subsection 2 title to include both redemption before foreclosure and purchase at court-directed sale.

headings.title: Dissolution by court decree on application of partner
headings.reviewNote: Lists grounds for judicial dissolution on partner application, including incapacity and breach.

headings.title: Dissolution on application of purchaser of interest
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes purchaser under assignment or charging order to seek judicial dissolution.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1949, 1983); partner-application grounds and purchaser-application dissolution under §§ 358.270–358.280 verified.

headings.title: Authority to bind partnership after dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Specifies acts winding up affairs or with creditors binding partnership after dissolution.

headings.title: Satisfaction of liability from partnership assets alone
headings.reviewNote: Limits unknown and inactive partner liability to partnership assets alone.

headings.title: Circumstances where partnership is not bound
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates situations where post-dissolution acts do not bind partnership, including bankruptcy.

headings.title: Partner by estoppel liability after dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Preserves partner by estoppel liability under section 358.160 after dissolution.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1949 source note; tightened subsection 4 title on post-dissolution § 358.160 partner-by-estoppel liability.

headings.title: Effect of dissolution on existing liability
headings.reviewNote: Provides dissolution does not of itself discharge existing liability of partners.

headings.title: Discharge by agreement among partner, creditor, and successor
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes discharge of partner liability by tripartite agreement or course of dealing.

headings.title: Discharge upon material alteration of assumed obligations
headings.reviewNote: Discharges partner when creditor consents to material alteration of assumed debt.

headings.title: Liability of deceased partner's individual property
headings.reviewNote: Subjects deceased partner's individual property to partnership debts subject to separate debts.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1949, 1995); post-dissolution liability retention, discharge methods, and deceased partner individual-property rule under § 358.150 verified.

headings.title: Written notice to known claimants upon dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Permits disposing of known claims via written notice stating required details, mailing address, bar warning, and at least 90-day deadline.

headings.title: Barring of known claims
headings.reviewNote: Bars known claims of partnerships dissolved without fraudulent intent after deadline or 120 days post-rejection; excludes contingent or post-dissolution claims.

headings.title: Notice of winding up for unknown claims
headings.reviewNote: Permits disposing of unknown claims by filing a notice of winding up stating a three-year bar (subdivision (3) states after publication; subsection 4 states after filing).

headings.title: Barring of unknown claims three years after notice
headings.reviewNote: Bars unnotified, unacted-upon, contingent, or post-dissolution claims unless enforced within three years after filing the notice of winding up.

headings.title: Enforcement of claims against assets or partners
headings.reviewNote: Limits claim enforcement to undistributed assets or partners up to distributed amounts.

headings.title: Definition of fraudulent intent
headings.reviewNote: Defines fraudulent intent where primary purpose was defrauding partners or creditors.

headings.title: Claims covered by insurance
headings.reviewNote: Exempts insured claims from barring provisions and allows suit through defendant ad litem.

headings.title: Enforceability of insured claim judgments
headings.reviewNote: Restricts judgments in insured suits to available insurance contracts.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1997 merged-bill note (dual effective dates 6-24-97 H.B. 655 and 5-20-97 S.B. 170); known/unknown claim bars, filing-vs-publication wording in subs 3–4, fraudulent intent, and insured-claim rules verified.

headings.title: Application of property upon rightful dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Provides for application of partnership property to liabilities and surplus payout.

headings.title: Rights of partners upon wrongful dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Specifies innocent partners' rights to continue business and damages, and wrongful partner's payout.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1949 source note; rightful dissolution (including § 358.360(2) bona fide expulsion) and wrongful dissolution rights verified.

headings.title: Creditors' rights upon partner admission or assignment
headings.reviewNote: Treats prior creditors as creditors of continuing partnership upon admission or assignment.

headings.title: Creditors' rights when remaining partner continues business
headings.reviewNote: Preserves prior creditors when all but one partner retire or assign.

headings.title: Creditors' rights when business continued without assignment
headings.reviewNote: Treats creditors as if assignment occurred when business continues with consent.

headings.title: Creditors' rights when partners assign to third persons
headings.reviewNote: Maintains creditor rights when partners assign to third persons who promise debt payment.

headings.title: Creditors' rights after wrongful dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Extends creditor rights when remaining partners continue business following wrongful dissolution.

headings.title: Creditors' rights after partner expulsion
headings.reviewNote: Protects creditors of dissolved partnership when business continues after partner expulsion.

headings.title: Limitation of third person liability to partnership property
headings.reviewNote: Restricts liability of third person entering continuing business to partnership property.

headings.title: Priority of dissolved partnership creditors over separate creditors
headings.reviewNote: Grants prior creditors priority over retiring or deceased partner claims against business.

headings.title: Preservation of creditor remedies for fraud
headings.reviewNote: Preserves creditors' right to set aside fraudulent assignments.

headings.title: Use of partnership or deceased partner name
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies continuing name use does not subject deceased partner property to liability.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1949 source note; tightened subsection 1 title; all ten continuing-business creditor and name-use subsections verified.

headings.title: Application for registration as limited liability partnership
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required contents of written LLP registration application to secretary of state.

headings.title: Execution of application
headings.reviewNote: Requires execution by majority of partners or authorized partner.

headings.title: Registration fee and deposit
headings.reviewNote: Mandates fee of twenty-five dollars per partner capped at one hundred dollars for general revenue.

headings.title: Duties of secretary of state upon filing
headings.reviewNote: Governs endorsement, filing, and return of application without requiring agent authority proof.

headings.title: Effective date of registration
headings.reviewNote: Sets effective date on filing conforming application and fee, or specified later date.

headings.title: One-year expiration of initial registration
headings.reviewNote: Provides initial registration expires one year after date unless renewed, withdrawn, or revoked.

headings.title: Good faith partner count error protections
headings.reviewNote: Excludes listed partner count as liability evidence and protects status for good faith errors.

headings.title: Exemption from fictitious name filing
headings.reviewNote: Exempts LLP applicants from filing under chapter 417 fictitious name statutes.

headings.title: Annual renewal of registration
headings.reviewNote: Governs renewal application procedure, fees, general revenue deposit, and one-year extension.

headings.title: Withdrawal of registration
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes withdrawal of registration by written notice with street address and twenty-dollar fee.

headings.title: Effect of cessation of registration
headings.reviewNote: Preserves prior registered status for periods before expiration or withdrawal.

headings.title: Articles of amendment or correction
headings.reviewNote: Specifies contents, execution, fees, and rule that post-filing changes do not affect status.

headings.title: Mandatory amendments within ninety days
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing amendment within ninety days for name change or registered office or agent change.

headings.title: Effective time of amendment or withdrawal
headings.reviewNote: Sets effective time upon filing with secretary of state unless otherwise provided.

headings.title: Secretary of state authority to provide forms
headings.reviewNote: Permits secretary of state to provide forms for initial, renewal, withdrawal, and amendment or correction filings.

headings.title: Removal of inactive records
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes secretary of state to remove withdrawn, revoked, or expired registrations from active records.

headings.title: Revocation for dishonored payment instrument
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes revocation of filing for dishonored fee payment and notice requirements.

headings.title: False filing penalty and unintentional error protection
headings.reviewNote: Designates knowingly false filings as class A misdemeanor and shields unintentional errors.

headings.title: Requirements for foreign limited liability partnerships
headings.reviewNote: Outlines registration requirements for foreign LLPs, including service of process appointment.

headings.title: Continuity of partnership and successor filings
headings.reviewNote: Provides LLP registration does not dissolve partnership and permits successor continuity.

headings.title: Military service fee waiver
headings.reviewNote: Waives application fee for active duty military or Missouri National Guard general partners.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1995–2014); adjusted subsection 15 title to preserve permissive 'may provide' and tightened subsection 18 title; all 21 LLP registration, fee, amendment, foreign LLP, and military waiver subsections verified.

headings.title: Required words or abbreviation in partnership name
headings.reviewNote: Requires inclusion of Registered Limited Liability Partnership, L.L.P., or LLP in name.

headings.title: Distinguishability of partnership name and written consent
headings.reviewNote: Requires distinguishable name from registered entities unless written consent is filed.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1995 source note; mandatory LLP name suffixes and distinguishability/consent rules verified.

headings.title: Persons entitled to reserve partnership name
headings.reviewNote: Specifies persons intending to organize LLP or change name eligible to reserve name.

headings.title: Procedure for reservation, duration, transfer, and cancellation
headings.reviewNote: Governs 60-day reservation up to 180-day maximum, transfer of name, and cancellation.

headings.title: Name reservation fee
headings.reviewNote: Sets twenty-five dollar fee for application, renewal, transfer, or cancellation deposited in general revenue.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1995, 2004); name reservation eligibility, 60-day/180-day cap, transfer, cancellation, and $25 fee verified.

headings.title: Requirement to maintain registered office and agent
headings.reviewNote: Requires maintaining registered office and registered agent within Missouri.

headings.title: Agent change of office address or name
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes registered agent to change address or name across represented partnerships with fees.

headings.title: Resignation of agent and appointment of successor
headings.reviewNote: Provides procedure and fee for agent resignation with ratified successor appointment.

headings.title: Resignation without successor and automatic cancellation
headings.reviewNote: Specifies 120-day delayed resignation, notice to partnership, and cancellation for failure to appoint.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1995 source note; tightened subsection 2 title; registered office/agent maintenance, resignation with successor, and 120-day resignation cancellation rules verified.

headings.title: Fees for certified copies
headings.reviewNote: Sets $5 certified copy fee (source reads verbatim 'written electronic' format) and $1 per additional page for written requests, deposited in general revenue.

headings.title: Certificates of good standing and abstract fees
headings.reviewNote: Sets five-dollar fee for certificates of good standing and filing abstracts.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1995, 2004); certified copy, good standing, and abstract fees verified (verbatim 'written electronic' wording in sub 1 noted).

headings.title: Extraterritorial conduct of business
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes Missouri partnerships to conduct business and exercise powers outside the state.

headings.title: Recognition of legal existence outside Missouri
headings.reviewNote: Directs full faith and credit and extraterritorial recognition of Missouri LLPs.

headings.title: Governing law for internal affairs of Missouri partnerships
headings.reviewNote: Establishes Missouri law governs internal affairs and partner liability of domestic partnerships.

headings.title: Governing law for internal affairs of foreign partnerships
headings.reviewNote: Subjects internal affairs and partner liability of foreign partnerships to jurisdiction of formation.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1995 source note; extraterritorial business authority, full faith and credit, and domestic/foreign internal affairs governing law verified.

headings.title: Registration of domestic limited partnership as LLLP
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes domestic LP to register as LLLP and accords partner liability protection.

headings.title: Registration of foreign limited partnership as LLLP
headings.reviewNote: Permits foreign LP to register as LLLP and preserves foreign liability protections.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1995–1998); domestic and foreign limited partnership registration as LLLP under chapters 358 and 359 verified.

headings.title: Authorization for merger or consolidation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes domestic general partnership to merge or consolidate with general partnerships or other entities.

headings.title: Partner approval required for merger agreement
headings.reviewNote: Establishes voting thresholds for merger approval in partnership agreement or default unanimity.

headings.title: Filing articles of merger or consolidation
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required contents of articles of merger or consolidation filed with secretary of state.

headings.title: Execution of certificate of merger or consolidation
headings.reviewNote: Requires execution of the 'certificate of merger or consolidation' (source wording) by at least one general partner of each domestic partnership and an authorized agent.

headings.title: Service of process certificate for surviving foreign partnership
headings.reviewNote: Requires foreign surviving or resulting partnership to attach irrevocable secretary of state service appointment and mailing address (source reads 'mailed ... to the secretary of state').

headings.title: Vesting of rights, property, and assumption of liabilities
headings.reviewNote: Vests rights and property in surviving entity and preserves creditor claims and liens.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1997, 2003); tightened subsection 3 title; noted source 'certificate' wording in sub 4 and 'to the secretary of state' mailing wording in sub 5.
